    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    index = 0
    t = int(input[index])
    index += 1
    results = []
    
    for _ in range(t):
        n = int(input[index])
        index += 1
        a = list(map(int, input[index:index + n]))
        index += n
        
        count = defaultdict(list)
        for i, x in enumerate(a):
            count[x].append(i)
        
        total_weight = 0
        for indices in count.values():
            m = len(indices)
            for i in range(m):
                total_weight += (indices[i] - (i if i == 0 else indices[i-1])) * (m - i - 1)
        
        results.append(total_weight)
    
    print('\n'.join(map(str, results)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
